title: Word slips: Floor ticket
summary: Split the line into maximal runs of non-space ASCII characters and produce each run's length. Multiple spaces, leading spaces and trailing spaces do not produce empty words. Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence.
descriptionMd:
A teleprinter uses runs of spaces to separate the words on its paper message roll. Pia is checking the lower stop before the ribbon press opens. A negative reading is a real measurement and must not be replaced by an invented zero.

Split the line into maximal runs of non-space ASCII characters and produce each run's length. Multiple spaces, leading spaces and trailing spaces do not produce empty words.

Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence.

Implement wordSlipsFloorTicket(line, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: String scanning. Split the line into maximal runs of non-space ASCII characters and produce each run's length. Multiple spaces, leading spaces and trailing spaces do not produce empty words. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys (earlier units are used while the first two levels establish the foundations).
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
The line contains ASCII characters; the only word separator is a space.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with string scanning. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

Split the line into maximal runs of non-space ASCII characters and produce each run's length. Multiple spaces, leading spaces and trailing spaces do not produce empty words. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [4,7]. Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 4.
The derived sequence is [2,3]. Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 2.
The derived sequence is []. Return the smallest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. This gives 0.
